versioning.reason: The initial pilot explicitly has no backup, restore, or recovery capability. Enabling object versions would create an undeclared recovery mechanism and extra retained storage cost.

source_dispositions.mindshare_public_site: DO_NOT_COPY; separately re-fetch from a reviewed public allowlist

admission_gates: authorized read-only enumeration of the exact approved source
size and SHA-256 recorded without uploading
destination key is under exactly one approved prefix
separate AWS resource and document-upload authorization completed
explicit_exclusions: credential, password, secret, token, API-key, private-key, license-secret, or environment files
backups, database dumps, recovery bundles, and vendor archive packages
raw CAD exports, raw CAD payloads, webhook bodies, incident records, unit records, and protected operational data
recordings, audio, transcripts derived from operational audio, and voice benchmark media
EMS, paging, station-alert, public-warning, radio, ESInet, acknowledgement, or other operational-output records
executables, installers, firmware, disk images, model files, and binary software packages
GIS geometry and structured tenant datasets, which require a separate GIS/data workflow
empty placeholders and generated sync-status metadata
